cards.title: Maya Devi Temple
cards.blurb: The white temple built over the marker stone said to show the exact spot where Siddhartha Gautama was born, in 623 BC by tradition. A UNESCO World Heritage Site.

cards.title: Ashoka Pillar
cards.blurb: Emperor Ashoka of the Maurya dynasty raised this sandstone pillar on his pilgrimage in 249 BC. Its Brahmi inscription is the oldest evidence of Lumbini as the Buddha's birthplace.

cards.title: Puskarini Sacred Pond
cards.blurb: The pond where Queen Maya Devi is said to have bathed before giving birth, and where the infant Buddha was given his first bath.

cards.title: World Peace Pagoda
cards.blurb: A gleaming white stupa built by Japanese Buddhists at the northern end of the monastic zone, with a golden Buddha in each niche.

cards.title: Monastic Zone
cards.blurb: Monasteries from Thailand, Myanmar, China, Germany and more stand either side of a long canal — the whole Buddhist world in one walk.

cards.title: Bodhi Seed Mala
cards.blurb: A string of 108 prayer beads made from bodhi seeds, sold by the stalls at the edge of the sacred garden.

cards.title: Cycle the Sacred Garden
cards.blurb: Hire a bicycle and cover the monastic zone before the midday heat, or walk it and see half. Roll for how far you get.

cards.title: Dal Bhat at the Dharamsala
cards.blurb: Lentils, rice, tarkari and achar, refilled until you say stop. Everyone at the table collects.

cards.title: Meditation Stillness Challenge
cards.blurb: Who can sit still the longest under the bodhi tree? Challenge one traveller — highest roll keeps their calm.
